caveat: Categories only. No colour, clarity or turbidity: illumination dominates the pixels and depth is not visible in a photograph. Counts are of what is VISIBLE, which is a lower bound.

records.notable: DEAD ANIMAL floating: a pale buff-brown carcass roughly 40 cm, persistent across four frames. A waterbird or a large fish — not resolvable which.
records.notes: NOT a member of the swan family: 2 adults and all 4 cygnets were counted alive in the same event. A mortality record the log did not have. §8 lists an abrupt fish kill as a water-health signal; a SINGLE carcass is not that, and should not be read as one.
records.model: Claude Opus 5, exhaustive visual sweep of all 262 photos
